The Pipeline Equation.teaches: Active fraction = min(1, supply/demand) as a knee curve: starved below, fed above; text job ~6000x headroom vs image job ~3.3x, and prefetch moves neither knee.
The Pipeline Equation.source: data-stall-frontier: notebook pipeline stalled at 0.8, image job 3.3x headroom, text job ~6000x; multi-worker mean ~1/6 of all-hot rate.

Checkpoint Storage.source: Two-phase checkpoint staging: local stripe ~0.34 s pause, ~2.45 s async copy, manifest publish last; pause = 22% of step, 0.17% of interval.
